name: Muzzle flash (toward camera)
description: A single one-frame star-shaped muzzle flash fired toward the camera, then a faint wisp of smoke.

looks.text: A close view of a muzzle flash fired toward the camera: flame shape and colour only.

prompt.subject: a gunshot muzzle flash toward the camera at {where}
prompt.timing: a single bright star-shaped muzzle flash bursts from {where} at {flash}, leaving a faint wisp of smoke that is gone by {clear}
prompt.action: At {flash} the gun fires toward the camera: a single brief star-shaped white-yellow muzzle flash lasting one frame bursts from {where}, lighting the shooter for an instant, followed by a faint wisp of gun smoke that quickly disappears.
